scope: Two producer primary sources with complete nominal outlines, implemented from the October manufacturer campaign. Source availability is not evidence of current physical production; section assignments are not a census of unique geometries.

records.title_original: PRESTRESSED CONCRETE BEAMS — SCIB CONCRETE MANUFACTURING SDN BHD
records.title_en: Prestressed Concrete Beams — SCIB Concrete Manufacturing
records.locator: Undated six-page catalogue, PDF page 6, three dimension groups I5-I8, I12-I14, I15-I18 and adjacent property tables.
records.printed_dimensions: Eleven gross nominal I-beams, 965-1830 mm deep. Top widths 360/410 mm, webs 150/200 mm, bottom widths 510/610/660 mm; printed flange, haunch and straight-web chains close exactly. Dimensions mm; A mm2; Yb/Yt mm; centroidal Ixx mm4; moduli mm3; weight kN/m.
records.missing_information: Gross nominal outlines are complete and implemented. No radius/chamfer dimension is printed; sharp intersections are a stated convention. Reinforcement, strand placement, local holes/end zones and project design are excluded. Catalogue is undated; current physical production and design approval are unverified.
records.property_verification: Independent printed table: all 11 areas exact; Yb within 0.489 mm; Ixx within 0.085 percent; moduli within 0.022 percent. I13 Zt 138.81e6 and I15 Zt 166.0e6 mm3 retained exactly.
records.geometry_duplicates: I5/I6/I7/I12/I13/I14 equal existing South African Civilcon nominal outlines; independent manufacturer/country assignments, not six distinct new shapes. I8/I15/I16/I17/I18 are distinct. SCIB M2-M10 corroborates OKA and is not added again.

records.title_en: Keehi IV and VI prestressed bridge girders
records.locator: PDF page 1 sheet K-VI W; page 2 K-VI; page 3 K-IV W; page 4 K-IV, including IV MOD additional-depth callout and property row.
records.printed_dimensions: Five gross nominal profiles. VI/VI W depth 72 in; IV/IV W 58 in; IV MOD 62 in. Web 7/6.5 in, base 26 in; top widths VI W 57 in maximum, VI 36 in, IV W 56.5 in maximum, IV/IV MOD 24 in. All depth chains printed; 3/4 in soffit chamfers and lower-web radii. Source units in, in2, in4, in3 and kip/ft; public geometry mm via exact 25.4 conversion.
records.missing_information: Complete as-drawn nominal profiles implemented, including maximum-width wide variants. Project-specific narrower flange geometry is unspecified and excluded; IV MOD uses the printed 4 in top addition. Reinforcement, local end details and project design are excluded. Sheets have blank issue/revision dates; PDF metadata from 2010 is not a drawing issue date. Current production and design approval are unverified.
records.property_verification: As-drawn corners vs source tables: area deficit 0.29-0.59 in2; Yb below 0.026 in difference; centroidal Ixx below 0.14 percent difference. Published IV/IV W/IV MOD/VI W mostly use the sharp outline without labelled corners; VI table has a further 0.012 percent nominal Ixx discrepancy. These differences are recorded without fitting dimensions.
records.geometry_duplicates: No nominal duplicate of these five polygons was found among the 1806 previously counted catalogue profiles.
